note: Recorded inputs of the 28 Oct 2026 placements (research/lens-calibration/2026-10-27-01/integration-001). Orientation, reference pose and tolerance are unchanged; the lens height and the IWR RX-row offset come from the rig file each time the placements are built (lens 93 mm and RX row 22.3 mm behind the lens since 2 Nov 2026; the 28 Oct files used 95 mm and 30 mm).

provenance.camera_origin: World horizontal origin directly below the lens; lens height {lens_height_mm:g} mm above the ground the enclosure stands on, from the rig file.
provenance.radar_origin: The rig file's IWR RX-row offset {iwr_offset_mm} mm (camera image axes) turned by the reference optical rotation, as the placement consistency check requires. Not an independent measurement.
provenance.pivot: Define the floor point directly below the reference lens as the computational rotation pivot. Physical support pivot is unmeasured; this is a fixed-setup experimental placement, not a measured mechanical pivot.
provenance.heading: Define target forward using the horizontal projection of the camera boresight for this owner-aimed initial test. Optical yaw relative to the housing/true shot line remains unmeasured.
provenance.reference_pose_basis: Current stable LIS3DH pitch and verified roll-zero-corrected roll, paired by owner confirmation of unchanged unit. This reading was taken after image capture, not simultaneously.
provenance.consumer_frame: Reference optical rotation in the owner-declared LFU frame; subsequent LIS3DH changes use the existing reference-pose delta.
limitations: Fixed-setup candidate; physical mechanical pivot unmeasured
Optical yaw relative to the housing and the shot line unmeasured
Phone-level, print/floor and optical-yaw uncertainties unqualified
